0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Lanille looks expectantly into the woods, as if waiting for someone.

48.original: Gods...that girl never listens...!?<hex:02100103>Oh! It is you. How much of my grumbling did you hear?

49.original: An elder's torment knows no end. I sent my niece out to gather branches for a bow, but she has yet to return. Knowing her pious nature, doubtless she is lost in prayer under some tree or the other.

50.original: While I would never deny her her faith, she must learn not to neglect her worldly duties. My warnings fall on deaf ears, however. Perhaps you can succeed where I failed. Could you speak with her on my behalf? She is likely somewhere in the Wild Fete.

51.original: I am at my wit's end, so I must ask for your help. Pray find my niece at the Wild Fete and instruct her to return here at once.

53.original: Oh, my apologies, I did not notice you. It is so easy to become lost in my quiet of the wood...

54.original: What? Lanille sent you? I see... It seems I must apologize for becoming your burden as well.

55.original: However, it would have been remiss of me to return without saying my proper benedictions. After all, a branch is but a gift of the wood, a piece of its life force that we must be grateful for.

56.original: This tree is said to be blessed by Yx'Maja, goddess of beauty and the hunt. It is only natural that I should say thanks here before receiving the wood's bounty.

57.original: Would you care to join me? Ask for the tree's protection, that you might be safeguarded from danger in the journey ahead.

58.original: Who knows what perils you may face in the future? <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Pray<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> for the blessing of the goddess to set your mind at ease.

59.original: The wood is waiting to give its blessing to any who would <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>pray<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> for it.

60.original: Very good. Now the goddess shall watch over your every step.

61.original: Now, I suppose it is time I seek out a suitable branch. Please tell Lanille that I shall be home soon.

62.original: You have returned. I hope she did not prove too troublesome.

63.original: So, even a warrior such as you can be convinced to say a humble prayer? Perhaps there is power in her conviction after all. Very well, I too shall pray that the goddess keeps you in good health.
